result.judge_notes: pass 1 (A=with, B=without): Both answers keep the old results and pins visible, place indicators in the filter bar, list and map, use 300ms and 1s thresholds, and handle failure with stale results, a plain-language banner and Retry. B only says to swap the count and cards together, though it adds useful extras such as a silent auto-retry and a first-load failure state. B is more explicit about avoiding layout shift: it reserves space for the label, count and banner. It also handles a map-only failure and keeps the dimmed cards clickable.
